items.title: Gerald Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Snooky Young comes out to join Lee Young, whose brother Lester Young is coming to join his brother on sax

ctx.x: So did you meet Gil? Did you get to know Gil?

Oh I know Gil, oh yeah I knew Gil real well yeah Gil was – he was with Les Hite’s band. See Dizzy and – and Gil Fuller played with Les Hite’s band. So when – when Les Hite came back to California, Dizzy and Gil Fuller didn’t come back, but they had a whole book full of Gil’s arrangements, and that’s when I went and joined Les Hite’s band. Now, you’re gonna want to hear this now. This is about Snooky Young, he’s back on the scene now. Look here. Snooky Young comes out to join Lee Young, whose brother Lester Young…
number like it was nothing, you know what I mean? And Benny was – he was so happy with that band. He was just really happy with that band.
